[[File:Vadim2020 avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Vadim2020.]]
'''Vadim2020''' is a 3-D modeler whose image is used on three [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Vadim2020 @ Sketchfab". The credit points to Sketchfab, a site for publishing 3-D models. The credited cards are [[Endurance|•Endurance]], [[Resolute|•Resolute]], and [[Utapau (Republic Controlled) / Utapau (Separatist Controlled)|•Utapau (Republic Controlled) / •Utapau (Separatist Controlled)]], in [[Virtual Set 21]] and [[Virtual Set 27]] (released 2023–2026).
